headline: Locals loot liquor bottles after mini-truck crashes in dry Bihar as driver flees
caption:
Dry state mein truck palta aur bottles ki barsaat ho gayi 😭

Uske baad locals ne gaadi se liquor bottles loot li.
Police ab CCTV footage aur social media videos check kar rahi hai, taaki loot karne walon ko book karke bottles wapas le sakein.

headline: Injured flydubai pilot Smit Machchhar tells PM Modi: "I could not let all those people die"
caption:

Unka kehna tha ki wo "could not let all those people die", aur injured hone ke baad bhi unhone "one last push" diya.

headline: Cockroach Janta Party Starts Nationwide Protest In Mumbai, Shabana Azmi Urges People To Join
caption:
Cockroach Janta Party ka protest ab Delhi ke baad Mumbai pahunch gaya hai 👀
CJP ne 2 October se nationwide protest announce kiya hai, jo Mumbai se start hua.
Unki demand hai ki Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar resign karein, voter list concerns ko lekar.
Actor Shabana Azmi ne logon se Mumbai protest mein join karne ko kaha: "Will see you there."
